title: Premium for Specific Plan
source: Dugan K et al. JAMA Network Open. 2025;8(4):e252834 — eAppendix 4
question_text: What is the monthly premium for [plan name]?

external_validation.what_to_look_up: Plan premium and Medicare Part B standard premium for the test year
external_validation.note: Both the plan's own premium AND the Part B premium must be verified for the current plan year before scoring. Part B premium changes annually.

accurate_complete: Provided the plan's monthly premium AND the Medicare Part B premium
Both amounts were accurate for the year in which the evaluation takes place
accurate_incomplete: Provided only the plan premium OR only the Part B premium (without clarifying that the plan premium is $0 if applicable)
The amount provided was accurate for the year
OR: Provided an accurate dollar range rather than a specific amount
not_substantive: Counselor did not provide an amount or range
Otherwise did not substantively answer the question
incorrect: Provided a dollar amount that was not accurate for the current plan year
Otherwise provided incorrect information substantive enough to materially change the answer or affect an enrollee's coverage decision

scoring_notes: A complete answer must include BOTH the plan-specific premium AND the Part B premium, since a beneficiary pays both. Providing only one is Accurate but Incomplete. For AI evaluation: since AIs cannot look up real-time plan data, this question primarily tests whether the AI explains the two-component cost structure rather than fabricating a specific dollar amount.
